verdict.rationale: Ramp documents trip-aware booking (policy status, per-diem, hotel rebooking), automatic card-swipe receipt capture with auto-filled memos/categories, and a first-class 'trips' resource/scope (trips:read/write) surfaced via the CLI and MCP, implying bookings, card spend, and receipts are tied to a trip entity. However, there is no explicit documentation describing an automatically assembled, itinerary-linked consolidated expense report combining bookings+cards+receipts end-to-end. Missing for 10: an explicit itinerary-to-report auto-consolidation feature description, and independent/hands-on confirmation that a trip report self-assembles without manual grouping.
